title: Unique Buttery Middle Eastern Apricots Harees
description: A buttery, crunchy, one-pot Middle Eastern dish featuring dried apricots, soffritto-base, and keto-friendly ingredients, formed into a traditional harees shape.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped dried apricots, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Use a fork to mash the mixture and form it into a harees shape.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped apricots if desired.
